name: maxun
method: Every edge that isn't imports, calls, renders, or handles read at its sites in `git show <sha>:<file>` (multi-line calls with `git grep -A`): an http edge's method and URL, `apiUrl` from src/apiConfig.js against the server's port, and the route's definition plus its router's `app.use` mount in server/src/server.ts; an external_call's client traced to its package import or literal host; each unresolved edge's reason against its URL. Then every `fetch(`, `axios`, Anthropic, googleapis, OAuth, Airtable, and MinIO call in src/, server/src/, browser/, and maxun-core/src/ (git grep) matched to an edge, so missing ones are written down.
notCovered: Structural edges (imports, calls, renders, handles) aren't hand-checked; they're TypeScript's resolution, tested by the fixtures and the eval. Route nodes are checked only where an edge points at them, plus the unmounted-router note below.
observations: Every `fetch(` and `axios` call in src/, server/src/, browser/, and maxun-core/src/ is on an edge, except `fetch(url, …)` inside mcp-worker.ts's `makeApiRequest` (line 147), whose callers carry the edges. All 74 frontend requests reach a route, and each answering route is the one Express would pick.

server/src/api/record.ts and sdk.ts (26 of the 101 routes) are mounted at `/api` by a loop, `readdirSync(path.join(__dirname, 'api')).forEach(r => app.use('/api', require(path.join(__dirname, 'api', r))))` (server/src/server.ts:133–141), which the analyzer doesn't follow. It warns `EXPRESS_UNMOUNTED_ROUTER` ("never mounted on an app; its routes use paths relative to the router") and labels them without the prefix, e.g. `GET /robots` for the real `GET /api/robots`. No edge points at them, so no edge is wrong, but on the demo those 26 route labels are short of `/api`, and the warning's "never mounted" overstates it. Planned as M9.1a5.

The 2 `NO_MATCHING_ROUTE` health checks (browserConnection.ts:25, 142) go to the browser service's raw `http.createServer` handler (browser/server.ts:42, `req.url === '/health'`), which no detector reads: a missing edge, shown unresolved rather than guessed. The third, `POST /integration/upload-credentials` (src/api/integration.ts:6), has no server route at all.

The 28 LLM requests (`/chat/completions`, `/api/chat`) are unresolved because their base is the user's configured endpoint (`config.baseUrl`), with api.openai.com or Ollama's localhost only as a fallback; drawing api.openai.com would guess which one a deployment uses.

Missing, not wrong: the database (Sequelize models; v1 reads Prisma only), MinIO object storage (`minioClient.putObject`/`getObject`, server/src/storage/mino.ts:131–305, package `minio`), the Airtable SDK's record calls (`base(tableName).select/destroy/create`, server/src/workflow-management/integrations/airtable.ts:507–556), Google's token exchange (`oauth2Client.getToken`, server/src/routes/auth.ts:401), and socket.io traffic between the frontend and the server.
